predictions.rationale: Defines the core "Critic" agent abstraction; all design critics inherit from this class. Central to creating, configuring, and executing critic logic.
Implements the agency that manages collections of Critic objects, schedules/background execution, and coordinates their interaction with the model.
Represents the active designer session; owns the Agency and ToDoList, tying critics’ results to the user’s workflow.
Holds the collection of improvement suggestions generated by critics; key data structure referenced throughout the critique feature.
Represents an individual critique suggestion returned by a Critic and displayed to the user.
Abstract control mechanism responsible for invoking critics automatically; orchestrates continuous background analysis.
Default implementation of ControlMech; provides concrete strategy for periodic critic execution and issue generation.
Application startup class that initializes and launches the critic subsystem’s background thread.
Encapsulates model elements implicated by a critic; vital for pinpointing and displaying design problems.
UI action that toggles automatic background critique on/off, directly supporting the continuous analysis behavior.
